record.notes: Adopted by the Saeima on 6 March 2025, promulgated on 19 March 2025 and in force from 20 March 2025, the day after promulgation. The centre had to be founded by 31 March 2025, the Cabinet's rules on the sandbox and on data processing in it were due by 31 May 2025, and the task of giving opinions on AI and deepfakes in elections applies from 1 June 2026. The council has nine members: one each from the Ministry of Smart Administration and Regional Development (VARAM), the Ministry of Economics and the Ministry of Defence, and members nominated by the private sector and the universities; the Saeima named the Latvian Information and Communication Technology Association and the Latvian Universities Association as the private and academic founders. VARAM supervises the centre's delegated public tasks. An amending law of 14 May 2026, in force from 1 June 2026, deleted Article 7(5). The law does not refer to Regulation (EU) 2024/1689; Latvia's AI Act authorities are set out in the Cabinet's 2025 implementation report (LV-02).

verification.note: Recheck of 17 Oct 2026: re-read the consolidated text on likumi.lv (version in force from 1 June 2026, stored 12 Oct 2026) and the Saeima press release of 7 March 2025 (stored again 17 Oct 2026; only the page furniture changed). likumi.lv confirms the title, adoption, promulgation, entry into force, the publication reference, the amendment of 14 May 2026 and the content of Articles 1 to 9 and the transitional provisions; the Saeima release confirms the founding members. Stored in this run: the State Language Centre's English translation on likumi.lv, which gives the English title 'Artificial Intelligence Centre Law'; it is valid for 20 March 2025 to 31 May 2026 and does not include the amendment of 14 May 2026. The bill number 811/Lp14 in version 1's identifier came from a tracker and is in no stored file, so it was removed.

title.quote: the President has proclaimed the following law: Artificial Intelligence Centre Law
This is stipulated in the Artificial Intelligence Centre Law, which was adopted in its final reading by the Saeima on Thursday, 6 March.

date_in_force.quote: Likums stājas spēkā nākamajā dienā pēc tā izsludināšanas.

date_last_updated.quote: (Ar grozījumiem, kas izdarīti ar 14.05.2026. likumu, kas stājas spēkā 01.06.2026.)

summary.quote: nodrošināt to, ka mākslīgā intelekta sistēmas tiek izmantotas ētiski, atbildīgi un droši, ievērojot cilvēka pamattiesības
sniegt atzinumu par mākslīgā intelekta sistēmu vai dziļviltojumu tehnoloģiju izmantošanas gadījumiem priekšvēlēšanu aģitācijas periodā
Mākslīgā intelekta sistēmas izstrāde un pārbaude nedrīkst apdraudēt valsts, sabiedrības, vides vai saimnieciskās darbības drošību vai cilvēku veselību un dzīvību.

notes.quote: Centra padomes sastāvā ir deviņi locekļi: pa vienam pārstāvim no Viedās administrācijas un reģionālās attīstības ministrijas, Ekonomikas ministrijas un Aizsardzības ministrijas, kā arī privātā sektora un augstskolu izvirzīti pārstāvji.

The private sector will be represented by the Latvian Information and Communication Technology Association, while higher education institutions will be represented by the Latvian Universities Association.
Šā likuma 4. panta pirmās daļas 3. punktā minēto uzdevumu centrs īsteno no 2026. gada 1. jūnija.

changes.notes: the council's composition restated as Article 7(3) gives it (three ministries plus members nominated by the private sector and universities); the ICT association and the universities' association are the founders named by the Saeima, not council seats in the law; the election task's start date added
changes.english_version: not recorded in version 1; the State Language Centre's English translation on likumi.lv (stored in this run) is a government translation; it predates the amendment of 14 May 2026

judgment.status_reasoning: The law entered into force on 20 March 2025, the day after promulgation on 19 March 2025; likumi.lv marks it 'Spēkā esošs' (in force), with the version from 1 June 2026 current after the amendment of 14 May 2026. The election-opinion task began on 1 June 2026, before today (17 October 2026). 'In force' stands.
judgment.scope_reasoning: The statutory mandate of a national AI centre whose aims include ethical, responsible and safe AI and reducing AI risks, with tasks on AI security risks, deepfakes in elections and a regulatory sandbox; in scope with no note, as in version 1.
judgment.date_reasoning: date_last_updated stays 1 June 2026, when the version with the amendment of 14 May 2026 took effect, as likumi.lv lists the versions; the adoption date of the amendment is in the notes.
